items.title: Sam Darnold: One TD, two turnovers in loss
items.text:
Darnold completed 18 of 29 passes for 195 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in Sunday's 32-29 loss to the 49ers. He added one rushing attempt for five yards.

items.title: Sam LaPorta: Leads air attack in lopsided victory
items.text:
LaPorta brought in all five of his targets for 88 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Fernando Mendoza: Sees first NFL action in Week 5 loss
items.text:
Mendoza completed six of eight passes for 48 yards without a touchdown or turnover in Sunday's 45-17 loss to the Patriots. He added three yards on his only carry.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jaylen Waddle: Makes just two catches Sunday
items.text:
Waddle corralled two of five targets for 19 yards and also had a nine-yard carry during Sunday's 23-17 road win against the Chargers.

items.title: George Kittle: Five short catches in Week 5 win
items.text:
Kittle (illness) caught five of six targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 32-29 win over the Seahawks.

items.title: Brock Purdy: Tosses two TDs to improve to 5-0
items.text:
Purdy completed 19 of 29 passes for 189 yards, two touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 32-29 win over the Seahawks. He also rushed five times for six yards and threw a successful two-point conversion.

items.title: Emanuel Wilson: Posts TD, fumble on 22 touches
items.text:
Wilson rushed 20 times for 61 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 32-29 loss to the 49ers. He also caught both of his targets for 11 yards and lost a fumble.

items.title: Kirk Cousins: Gives way to Mendoza late in rout
items.text:
Cousins completed 19 of 28 passes for 243 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-17 loss to the Patriots.
